records.public_claim_text: FAO will continue to encourage and support Members and stakeholders to actively participate in the global food safety governance discussions and activities.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: FAO will continue to encourage and support Members and stakeholders to actively participate in the global food safety governance discussions and activities.

records.public_claim_text: FAO will continue to reach out to diverse stakeholders and broaden the support towards international standards development.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: FAO will continue to reach out to diverse stakeholders and broaden the support towards international standards development.

records.public_claim_text: The Organization will further provide integrated and coherent assistance to countries in regulating and monitoring the use of antimicrobials and in preventing and minimizing the development and further spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) within the agrifood system, to humans and in the environment, and limit its effect on the safety and integrity of the food chain.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: The Organization will further provide integrated and coherent assistance to countries in regulating and monitoring the use of antimicrobials and in preventing and minimizing the development and further spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) within the agrifood system, to humans and in the environment, and limit its effect on the safety and integrity of the food chain.

records.public_claim_text: This will entail support to policy makers and other relevant stakeholders to better convey the impact of food safety on society, specifically on health and livelihoods.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: This will entail support to policy makers and other relevant stakeholders to better convey the impact of food safety on society, specifically on health and livelihoods.

records.public_claim_text: Events such as the World Food Safety Day can help raise awareness on how food safety underpins food security and trade, and how it influences the economy and private industries.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Events such as the World Food Safety Day can help raise awareness on how food safety underpins food security and trade, and how it influences the economy and private industries.

records.public_claim_text: This will also help to secure investments towards improved food safety, including through capacity development, infrastructure, data management, and partnerships.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: This will also help to secure investments towards improved food safety, including through capacity development, infrastructure, data management, and partnerships.

records.public_claim_text: It also uses forward-looking approaches such as foresight and horizon scanning to proactively identify emerging issues and to assess their food safety implications.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: It also uses forward-looking approaches such as foresight and horizon scanning to proactively identify emerging issues and to assess their food safety implications.

records.public_claim_text: These approaches can help to evaluate trends and drivers, as well as issues of regulatory significance, and quickly alert decision-makers and policymakers so they can make informed and appropriate decisions.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: These approaches can help to evaluate trends and drivers, as well as issues of regulatory significance, and quickly alert decision-makers and policymakers so they can make informed and appropriate decisions.

records.public_claim_text: In this regard, for FAO to continue to provide cutting-edge and useful information in support of Members’ and Codex’s time-sensitive decisions, it must continue to update and revise the methods and approaches underpinning risk assessment and risk-based advice.

records.public_claim_text: This raises the importance of producing sex-disaggregated data when pertinent for understanding and addressing gender and social inequalities as underlying causes of value chain inefficiencies and that may constrain the uptake of food safety measures.
